senses.gloss: गो—चन्दन n. (= -शीर्ष) a kind of sandal-wood, Suśr.
गो—चन्दना f. a sort of venomous leech, ib.
गो—चपला f. N. of the daughter of Raudrāśva and Ghṛtācī, Hariv. 1662.
गो—चर m. pasture ground for cattle, ĀpŚr. i, 2, 4

range, field for action, abode, dwelling-place, district (esp. ifc. ‘abiding in, relating to’; ‘offering range or field or scope for action, within the range of, accessible, attainable, within the power’), KaṭhUp. iii, 4; Mn. x, 39; MBh. &c.

the range of the organs of sense, object of sense, anything perceptible by the senses, esp. the range of the eye (e.g. लोचन-गोचरं-√ या, to come within range of the eye, become visible, Pañcat.), MBh. vii, 5616; Suśr.; Vikr. iv, 9 &c.
the distance of the planets from the Lagna and from each other, VarBṛS. civ, 2; Romakas.
(also) a place where birds are fed, Jātakam.
गो—चर mf(आ)n. being within the range of, attainable for (gen.), BhP. iii, 25, 28
perceptible (esp. to the eye), MBh. xiii, 71, 33 and 91, 24
having (or used in) the meaning of (loc.), L., Sch.
गो—चर—गत mfn. one who has come within the range of or in connection with (gen.), Bhartṛ.
गो—चर—ता f. the state of being liable to (in comp.), Sarvad. iv, 253
गो—चर—त्व n. id., 42
गो—चर—प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
गो—चर—फल n. N. of VarBṛS. civ
गो—चर—पीडा f. inauspicious position of stars within the ecliptic, VarBṛS. xli, 13
गो—च˚राध्याय m. = ˚र-फल
गो—च˚रान्तर-गत mfn. being within the power of (gen.), Pañcat.
गो—च˚री—कृत mfn. within the range of observation, Sāh. iii, 28 a/b
overcome (by fatigue, ग्लान्या), Hcar. v, 139.
गो—˚चरय Nom. P. ˚यति, to be current, Yājñ. ii, 96 a/b.
गो—˚चरिक mfn. ‘accessible to’, a friend of (in comp.), Divyāv.
गो—चर्मन् n. an ox-hide, cow's hide, MBh. xiii, 1228

a particular measure of surface (a place large enough for the range of 100 cows, one bull, and their calves, Gṛhyās.; or a place ten times as large, Parāś. xii; a place 300 feet long by 10 broad, W.; or a place 30 Daṇḍas long by 1 Daṇḍa and 7 Hastas broad, Bṛhasp. [MBh. xiii, 3121, Sch.]; it is also defined as an extent of land sufficient to support a man for a year, Viṣṇ. v, 181 ff.; originally probably a piece of land large enough to be encompassed by straps of leather from a cow's hide, cf. ŚBr. i, 2, 5, 2), MBh. xiii, 3121; Hcat. i, 3, 864 ff.; ii, 1; BṛNārP. xxxiv, 43.
गो—चर्म-मात्र mfn. (land &c.) measuring a bull's hide, Baudh.
गो—चर्या f. seeking food like a cow, BhP. xi, 18, 29.
गो—चारक m. a cowherd, W.
गो—चारण n. the tending of cows, x, 38, 8.
गो—चारिन् mfn. one who seeks his nourishment like a cow, seeking food with the mouth (said of certain Yatis, cf. मृग-च्˚), MBh. xiii, 647 (cf. i, 3644.)
गो—चिति f. a particular way of piling up sacrificial bricks, ĀpŚr. xvii, 4.
गोच्छा f. the furrow of the upper lip, VarBṛS. lviii, 9 (cf. गो-ख, p. 364, col. 1.)
गोच्छाल m. the plant Kulāhala (or अलम्बुष; ‘the palm of the hand with the fingers extended’, W.), L.
